name: Lacospo BAD END
original_name: ラコスポバッドエンド
source: Evil prince Lacospo kidnaps Mikan to lure and capture her allies. Using nanomachine brainwashing, he transforms them, including Golden Darkness, into his loyal slaves, systematically crushing Rito and claiming Lala and her sisters for his harem.
translation: 邪恶王子拉科斯波绑架了麦肯，以引诱并捕获她的盟友。他利用纳米机器洗脑，将包括金色黑暗在内的她们变成了他忠诚的奴隶，系统性地摧毁了莉托，并将拉拉和她的姐妹们纳入了他的后宫。
